table.name: TLGNC_TRAILER
table.description: Trailers are used for road order deliveries, but only in combination with a truck. They have very similar basic attributes as trucks.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The carrier (in German: Transporteur, Spediteur, Lieferant) who owns the trailer.

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive/deleted, 1=active.

column.name: TRAILER_NAME
column.description: Name (ID) of the trailer as displayed in the UI, with formatting. This is typically a shortened form of carrier + some enumeration, but must also be unique because it's used for display/selection in Logon. Example: TR Crh SG 44

column.name: TRAILER_PLATE_NO
column.description: Text on the number plate of the truck. Serves as alternative identifier for a truck, and must therefore be unique. Changeable plates (one plate for two trailers) are forbidden because they are used for the alternative RFID object label, and duplicates not allowed there.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_NO
column.description: SAP Number of the trailer. Field is going to be used in export interfaces to SAP.

column.name: TRAILER_TRSP_CAT_CD
column.description: FK trlgr_trailer_trsp_cat_bs. E.g. Silo, Container. Logic: Silo -> TRAILER_TYPE_CD needs to be liegend, mehrkammersilo or kippbar. Container -> TRAILER_TYPE_CD needs to be container.

column.name: TRAILER_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_trailer_type_bs. E.g. Horizontal (Liegend), Multi chamber Silo, Tiltable (Kippbar), Container.

column.name: MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Maximal gross weight of the COMPOSITION, i.e. TRUCK(!)+trailer+load. This is the legal max weight (e.g. because of brake power), and is sent to parallel as the limit for 'load a full truck composition'. For a truck of type 'semi-trailer truck' (=trsp_cat_cd: Trailer), truck.max_gross_weight_t is irrelevant to Logon and tlgnc_trailer.max_gross_weight_t is used instead. The max_net_weight_chamber1/2_t cannot be used as a limit, they are just hints for the dispatcher.

column.name: TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Weight of the empty trailer in tons. Typically this is measured in steps of 10kg

column.name: MANUFACTURER
column.description: Manufacturer of the trailer. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: AXIS_COUNT
column.description: Number of axis of the trailer. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon. No consistency check with TRAILER_TYPE_CD. User is free to enter 3+3 to describe truck+trailer compositions.

column.name: VOLUME_M3
column.description: Loading volume of the trailer in cubic meters. Logon does not have any logic attached to this volume; it is never the limiting factor for a load. This is in contrast to rail wagons, where the load limit can be either volume or weight, depending on the material density.

column.name: BRANDING_FLAG
column.description: 0=no, 1=yes, null=unkown/does not matter. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: The ID which is used to associate this object (trailer) with RFID tags. An RFID object can have several RFID tags.

column.name: CURRENT_TRUCK_ID
column.description: Trailer's current truck, referenced truck neetds to have truck_transport_cat_cd (T'Kategorie) = Trailer. Needs to be set at the moment when the trailer is loaded, can't be modified as long as the trailer is loaded. TLGNC_TRUCK_TRAILER_HISTORY tells the history of the values assigned to this field.

column.name: NR_CHAMBERS
column.description: Number of chambers. For silo trucks 1 or 2, 0 for other truck types.

column.name: MAX_NET_WEIGHT_CHAMBER1_T
column.description: For silo trailers only. Maximal net weight chamber 1. Defaults to MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T - TARA_WEIGHT_T. Set to 0 if not a silo trailer. There is no logic/limitation bound to the max_net_weight_chamber1/2, it is for informational purposes only in Disposition. Most silo trailers actually have two chambers, and 3 loading openings: front, both, back.

column.name: MAX_NET_WEIGHT_CHAMBER2_T
column.description: For silo trailers only. Maximal net weight chamber 2 (0, if trailer has only one chamber or is a silo trailer)

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IS_INTERNAL_FLAG
column.description: Internal means owned by Crh company => relevant for costs calculation in SAP Yes/no/Null not applicable. Copied value from tlgns_sap_vehicle.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_CHAR_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_sap_vehicle_characteristic_bs.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: NULL for generic trucks for planning. Copied value from tlgns_sap_vehicle. SAP_TRAILER_TYPE_CD at the time of last update/creation.
